_readme: Prompts for the AI-generated TOFU and BOFU photos (client style: warm golden-hour, realistic US industry scenes, like Sequifi_Meta_Ads_4x5_36_creatives). Generated with Figma AI, model gpt-image-2.5-sunburst. 'size' is the requested width x height. Each prompt = scene + composition (fitted to the card layout) + the shared style. MOFU Fiber (v3, client feedback: imagery specific to residential fiber, door-to-door fiber sales and telecom) uses 'style_mofu', a bright-daylight look kept deliberately distinct from the golden-hour TOFU set; generated with Figma AI (gpt-image-2.5-sunburst) in Figma file lUJhonGIKABZ6TxI8nt2Hi.
style: Photorealistic commercial advertising photograph, warm golden-hour sunset light with soft rim light, realistic American suburban setting, authentic confident approachable people, natural skin tones, shallow depth of field, full-frame camera, rich but realistic color grading, high detail, editorial advertising quality. No text, no lettering, no signage, no logos, no brand names, no watermarks.
style_mofu: Photorealistic documentary-style commercial advertising photograph, bright clean late-morning daylight under a clear blue sky (or soft even window daylight indoors), crisp cool-neutral colour grade with clean whites, soft blues and fresh greens, airy and optimistic, realistic American residential neighbourhood, authentic people with natural skin texture, full-frame camera, high detail. Physically coherent scene: every person is a separate, complete body; no person overlaps, merges with or passes through a door, cabinet, vehicle or another person; anatomically correct hands and arms. Deliberately NOT golden hour: no sunset, no warm orange or amber cast, no lens flare. No text, no lettering, no numbers, no signage, no logos, no brand names, no stickers with writing, no watermarks.

layouts.T1: Wide landscape frame. A spreadsheet overlay will cover the LOWER THIRD and lower-left of the photo, so keep the main subject and faces in the UPPER 60% of the frame, centered to right. Lower third can be simple foreground.
layouts.T2: Near-square frame. A UI panel will cover the UPPER-RIGHT quarter, so place the main subject in the LEFT HALF and lower two-thirds; upper right is open soft-focus background. Lower-left foreground slightly darker and calm.
layouts.T3: Tall portrait frame. A card overlay will cover the LEFT 45% across the middle of the photo, so place the main subject and faces on the RIGHT SIDE of the frame, full height. Left side is soft background.
layouts.T4: Tall portrait frame. Main subject centered, face in the upper half; the lower-left corner is calm and slightly darker for a handwritten caption.
layouts.T5: Tall 4:5 hero frame for a full-bleed ad. Main subject in the UPPER-MIDDLE of the frame (between 15% and 65% height); the LOWER THIRD is calm, simple and slightly darker (lawn, driveway or road) for a headline and button; the top-left corner is plain sky for a logo.
layouts.B1: BOFU banner 1. Mortgage: tall portrait, owner on the LEFT watching a demo (call window covers the right). Roofing: blank white yard sign facing camera straight on in the lower-middle (the headline is printed onto it), new roof + crew above. Fiber: straight-down aerial of a suburban street running diagonally lower-left to upper-right. Solar: hand holding a phone straight-on with a blank black screen (the live app is placed into the screen), solar roof behind.
layouts.B2: BOFU banner 2. Mortgage: rep slightly left of center (frosted scene, clear pane). Roofing: split-screen before/after of the same house, storm left / clear golden sky right, seam at the exact center. Fiber: macro of a cable entering from the left with color-coded strands fanning right across the middle band, dark empty top and bottom. Solar: home with panels in the lower-middle, vast clear sky, sun low at the far right.
layouts.HOST: Square webcam-style tile: head and shoulders, face centered, looking at camera.
layouts.M1: MOFU card 1. Wide landscape frame shown as a small 320 x 196 thumbnail on the activated-install deal card: one clear subject filling the centre so it reads at thumbnail size; the top-left corner is plain (status chip) and the middle of the right edge is covered by a round app icon.
layouts.M2: MOFU card 2. Wide landscape frame cropped to a 1080 x 580 band across the top of the card: the top 15% sits under a dark gradient with the logo and pill, and the image fades to white from mid-height into the headline. Keep every person inside the 15%-55% height band, spread horizontally; lower half plain sidewalk or lawn.
layouts.M3: MOFU card 3. Square frame shown as an 84 x 84 avatar on the top-earner profile chip: tight head-and-shoulders, face centred and filling the middle third, plain softly blurred background.
layouts.M4: MOFU card 4. Landscape 5:4 photo in a white-bordered print tilted -3 degrees (450 x 360): all people inside the middle 80% of the frame, faces in the upper half.
layouts.M5: MOFU card 5. Tall 4:5 hero cropped to the top 1010 px of the card: top 12% under a dark gradient (logo left, pill right), image fades to white from about 52% height into the headline and button. Main subject between 12% and 55% height; lower half simple and light (pavement, lawn).

Mortgage/T1.scene: A loan officer in a navy blazer at a desk in a bright, modern home-lending office by a window at golden hour, reviewing a stack of mortgage paperwork with a calculator, laptop and a small wooden house model on the desk; thoughtful, slightly concentrated expression.

Mortgage/T5.scene: Wide shot of an elegant two-story suburban family home with a front porch and manicured lawn at golden hour; on the porch a loan officer hands house keys to a smiling couple; mature trees, soft hills in the distance, warm sky.

Roofing/T2.scene: A roofer in a white hard hat, safety harness and work gloves kneeling on a pitched roof, nailing new charcoal architectural shingles with a pneumatic nail gun; focused expression; warm low sun.

Roofing/T3.scene: A roofing project manager in a navy polo shirt holding a tablet, smiling and talking with a homeowner in the driveway of a suburban house with a freshly installed new roof, golden hour.

Roofing/T4.scene: A smiling roofer in a white hard hat and hi-vis vest kneeling on a sunlit residential roof, holding a bundle of shingles on his shoulder, looking toward the camera, warm sky and treetops behind.

Roofing/T5.scene: A beautiful suburban two-story home with a brand-new dark architectural shingle roof at golden hour; two roofers in hard hats stand on the roof ridge finishing the job, warm sunset sky, trees and soft hills behind.

Fiber/T1.scene: Inside the open back of a fiber service van at dusk, a technician in a hi-vis vest uses a fusion splicer on a splice tray full of brightly colored fiber optic strands; warm work light on his face, organized tools and fiber cable reels around him.

Fiber/T3.scene: A fiber installation technician in a hi-vis yellow vest over a navy shirt and a navy cap, handing a new white fiber router to a smiling homeowner at the open front door of a suburban home at golden hour. BOTH people in the RIGHT HALF of the frame (homeowner in the doorway at the far right, technician just left of the door facing her); the left 45% is soft background only (porch railing, plants, lawn, sunset sky). (v2: regenerated so the technician's face clears the statement card)

Fiber/T4.scene: A friendly door-to-door fiber internet sales rep in a plain navy polo shirt, holding a tablet, walking along a suburban sidewalk at golden hour, confident smile.

Fiber/T5.scene: A fiber crew with a white bucket truck stringing aerial fiber optic cable along utility poles on a tree-lined suburban street at golden hour; a lineman in a hard hat in the raised bucket; warm sunset sky, soft hills behind.

Solar/T1.scene: Wide shot of three solar installers in hard hats and harnesses mounting black solar panels on the roof of a suburban house at golden hour, panels and racking rails visible.

Solar/T2.scene: A solar installer in a white hard hat, hi-vis vest and gloves carrying a black solar panel across a shingled residential roof, mid-stride, focused; warm low sun.

Solar/T3.scene: A solar installer in a white hard hat, hi-vis vest and gloves commissioning a newly installed home battery and inverter on the exterior side wall of a suburban house, checking the system on a tablet; black solar panels on the roof edge above; plain unbranded equipment. Installer, battery and inverter in the RIGHT HALF; left 45% soft background (side yard, fence, sunset sky). (v2: replaced a sales-consultant scene that duplicated Roofing card 3; matches the statement's 'Battery & panel adders' line)

Solar/T4.scene: A smiling solar installer in a hard hat and hi-vis vest standing on a residential roof beside a row of black solar panels, arms relaxed, warm sunset sky behind.

Solar/T5.scene: A modern suburban home with a full rooftop array of sleek black solar panels glowing in golden-hour light, mountains and a warm sunset sky behind, a clean driveway and lawn in front.

Fiber/M1.scene: Interior product photograph in a bright modern American home: a small plain white fiber optical network terminal (ONT) box mounted on a light grey wall, two small green status lights lit on its front edge, a thin yellow fiber optic patch cable with a green connector running neatly down from the bottom of the box into a small plain white fiber wall outlet just below it; on a light oak shelf a little to the right, a plain white Wi-Fi router. Soft daylight from a window on the left. Composition: the ONT is centred and large enough to read clearly as a small thumbnail; the top-left corner is plain wall; keep the middle of the right edge free of important detail. (v3 MOFU, Figma node 1:2)

Fiber/M2.scene: Wide eye-level street photograph across a quiet tree-lined American suburban street on a bright clear morning: a door-to-door fiber internet sales team of four reps (two women and two men of varied ethnicities) in matching plain light-grey polo shirts with navy lanyards and blank white ID badges, standing in a loose row on the sidewalk facing the camera at three-quarter angles, with a clear gap of open space between every person so no one overlaps anyone else; they smile and chat; the team lead, a woman standing at the far RIGHT end of the row, extends her right arm to gesture toward the empty street on the right side of the frame, her arm crossing only empty space; two reps hold tablets in plain dark cases at chest height, one holds a small stack of blank white door hangers; a plain white unbranded van is parked at the curb on the far LEFT, behind and clear of the people; neat two-story homes, green lawns, blue sky. Composition: camera at chest height from across the street so the people are medium-small in the frame; the group of four occupies only the middle 60% of the frame width, the leftmost person standing at least a quarter of the frame width in from the left edge; every head sits between 35% and 45% of the frame height, with generous open sky and treetops above them and nothing but sky and leaves in the top-left quarter; all four complete from head to shoes; the bottom quarter is empty sidewalk. (v3 MOFU, Figma node 10:2)

Fiber/M3.scene: Head-and-shoulders portrait of a friendly Latina door-to-door fiber internet sales rep in her early thirties, dark hair tied back, plain light-grey polo shirt with a navy lanyard and blank white ID badge, warm confident smile looking straight at the camera, standing on a sunny residential street; softly blurred green trees, a white house and blue sky behind. Face centred and filling the middle third of the frame, 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field. (v3 MOFU, Figma node 4:2)

Fiber/M4.scene: In a bright, airy modern kitchen with soft window daylight, a friendly door-to-door fiber internet sales rep, a young Black man in his late twenties in a plain light-grey polo shirt with a navy lanyard and blank white ID badge, sits on a stool at a white kitchen island beside a smiling homeowner couple, a man and a woman in their thirties, who lean in to look; he holds a tablet in a plain dark-grey case angled toward them, the screen facing away from the camera and the back of the tablet completely plain with no logo; a small plain white Wi-Fi router sits on the counter. Composition: the three people grouped in the centre with natural clear separation, all three faces in the upper half of the frame. (v3 MOFU, Figma node 5:2)

Fiber/M5.scene: A fiber optic technician in a white hard hat, hi-vis yellow vest and work gloves stands on a residential sidewalk to the RIGHT of a large open grey fiber distribution cabinet, connecting a fiber patch cord inside it. The cabinet has a single door that is swung wide open to the LEFT, away from the technician, so there is clear empty space between him and the door and nothing overlaps his body. Inside the cabinet: neatly routed bundles of thin yellow fiber patch cords and rows of small green connectors. Bright clear daylight, blue sky, homes, lawns and trees softly blurred behind. Composition: square frame; the cabinet and technician sit in the upper-middle of the frame (between 12% and 60% of the height), the technician's hard hat below the top 12%; the top-left corner is plain sky or soft trees; the lower third is plain light concrete sidewalk with nothing important. (v3 MOFU, Figma node 7:2)
